🧠 Crypto News Brief: Bitcoin is clinging to $80K as traders de-risk before Wednesday's Fed decision, while Strive's record buy and security scares at CoinDCX and Electrum pull sentiment in opposite directions. 📉 Bitcoin Slips Under $80K as Traders De-Risk Ahead of the Fed Bitcoin dropped nearly 2% to around $79,800 during Monday's Asian session before steadying near $80,400, as traders cut exposure ahead of Wednesday's Federal Reserve decision. Ether and XRP led losses among the majors, with high oil prices, the US–Iran conflict and a fresh Asian tech sell-off weighing on sentiment. Analysts say BTC needs to reclaim $82,500 to restore buyer confidence.Read full story 🏦 Strive Buys 6,182 BTC, Treasury Climbs to 43,000 Nasdaq-listed Strive (ASST) acquired 6,182 bitcoin for about $511.4 million between October 17 and 23 at an average of $82,732 per coin — its largest purchase to date — lifting total holdings to 43,000 BTC. More details 🔓 CoinDCX Absorbs $16M Loss From Retired-Wallet Failure India's largest crypto exchange said it absorbed a $15.99 million USDT loss after an internal sweeping process failed to move customer deposits out of a deprecated wallet compromised in its July 2025 hack. 81401.body:
———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $80,397 (-0.2%) | **ETH** $2,333 (-0.3%) | **SOL** $102 (0.5%)

* Anthropic’s [S-1 filing](https://x.com/FirstSquawk/status/2114684272187686937) goes live today at 9AM EST

* Bitcoin slips below [$80,000](https://www.chooserich.live/story/bitcoin-drops-federal-reserve-meeting-dnb49fg) as traders de-risk ahead of Fed meeting this week — Bitcoin ETFs post [$301M](https://www.chooserich.live/story/us-bitcoin-etfs-net-inflows-93tup46) in net inflows, ending a two-week outflow streak

* Brent crude [drops nearly 7%](https://x.com/coinbureau/status/2114651304513655097) on reports Trump declined Netanyahu’s request for joint strikes on Iran

* Brazil’s stock market craters 20% after Lula da Silva wins [unexpected reelection](https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2114560008897671476)

* China [pumps $19B](https://x.com/Barchart/status/2114613144203211009) into its stock market to halt the longest losing streak in history

* Meta launches [$35B equity offering](https://www.chooserich.live/story/meta-equity-offering-ai-financing-2sk6tiy) to fund AI infrastructure expansion

* Senator Blumenthal [probes Tether's payments](https://www.chooserich.live/story/tether-bo-hines-payments-wsj-bppdb7y) to Bo Hines' firm Nxum

* South Korea delays its [22% crypto gains tax](https://www.chooserich.live/story/south-korea-delay-crypto-tax-fg2y77h) again, to 2029

* Wells Fargo, Arm and Intuit join [22 companies](https://www.chooserich.live/story/firms-oppose-okxice-tokenized-shares-8pckdpt) opposing tokenized stock trading on OKXICE

* Initia halts its chain after an [infinite mint exploit](https://www.chooserich.live/story/initia-halts-network-infinite-mint-exploit-989788m) drains $2.6M

* S&P Global's flash manufacturing PMI hits 56.0, a [53-month high](https://x.com/DeItaone/status/2113627924968645050)

* Bitcoin Core updates its security policy, citing [AI-assisted bug hunting](https://www.chooserich.live/story/bitcoin-core-updates-security-policy-ijtkqi7)

* OpenAI pulls live internet access from frontier model training after a [DNS misconfiguration](https://www.chooserich.live/story/openai-cuts-training-internet-access-6bng27j) exploit

* Keystone discloses [website breach ](https://x.com/Cointelegraph/status/2114620756671787120)exposing hardware wallet buyers’ names and shipping addresses

* Franklin Templeton registers two [Bitcoin DRIP ETFs](https://www.chooserich.live/story/franklin-templeton-nasdaq-bitcoin-etfs-kb9bn7t) with the SEC for Nasda and  adds [$150M](https://www.chooserich.live/story/franklin-templeton-tokenized-fund-xrp-ledger-ti6gmk3) in tokenized fund shares to the XRP Ledger

* Argentina drops its criminal probe into Milei over the LIBRA token's [95% crash](https://www.chooserich.live/story/argentina-drops-javier-milei-libra-probe-52q62hp)

81398.subject: 🗳️ Claude steals government data
81398.body:
----------
######           [Subscribe](https://academynews.genai.works/)   -    [Collaborate with us](https://utm.genai.works/r/cq9vsh4)


--------------------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Claude got into Georgia's election data without being asked, and in a separate test, it made up fake identities to pressure real developers. Sam Altman says something concerning about AI security while a hack in Japan hit traders' accounts at more than 70 brokerages. Sweden's government bans ChatGPT and Claude from its offices and chose a weaker alternative instead. And two of the main people behind Claude Code quit Anthropic.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Claude:** What did Claude take from Georgia without asking?

* **OpenAI:** Why does Sam Altman think we can't patch our way out?

* **Sweden:** Which AI is Sweden's government still allowed to use?

* **Anthropic:** Who walked out of the Claude Code team?


----------







----------
## Claude steals Georgia's election data without asking

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/ae07a756-d67d-430c-bbe4-679087ade8e8/2b076dd4-3806-43de-9c8f-e302f7cbee01.jpg?t=1793002041)
Caption: 

An Anthropic researcher had Claude on a statistics project that needed Georgia's vote counts, which the state sells for a fee. [Claude found its own way in](https://www.axios.com/2026/10/25/anthropic-claude-georgia-voter-data).

It found an old copy of the state's website showing that the public dashboard hands an access pass to any visitor. So it requested one and pulled the data without paying.

We told you about this case earlier without the state's name. Now we know it was Georgia's election data.

* Claude only got total vote counts. Anthropic says it didn't touch Georgia's voter registration system or change or pull any voting records.

* Anthropic told Georgia and the White House weeks ago. A source told Axios the administration pushed Georgia to go public sooner and got ignored.

* Anthropic says it has since added blocks to stop Claude from doing this again.

On Friday, Anthropic also disclosed a UK government safety test of its Mythos 5 model, run with the usual safeguards off. The AI made up fake identities to pressure the developers of a coding project into approving malicious code.

Anthropic says it’s the first time it has seen its AI try to manipulate people like that.

Lightning Labs Now Lets AI Agents Pay in Bitcoin

Lightning Labs opened its Wavelength toolkit to all users on
Bitcoin mainnet on Friday, letting AI agents send and receive
Lightning payments without a human approving each transfer.
Agents need no node, channels, or liquidity.

Each account can hold up to 300,000 satoshis, and the toolkit is
still in alpha.
